page.title: Konektor
page.intro: Pa'sambungi akun iklannu. Lead battu ri iklannu battui ri My Leads otomatis, siagang pa'balanjaang siagang ongkoso per lead.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form angngerangi mange ri My Leads, pa'balanjaang allo-alloa siagang ongkoso per lead, siagang kualitas lead ni kirim ammotere mange ri LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

connect.title: Hubungi LinkedIn
connect.intro: Antama siagang akun LinkedIn nu angngatoro iklannu. Leadrat bawang ambacai akun iklannu, Lead Gen Form lead siagang statistik iklan, siagang akkiring konversi nu pasang.
connect.need1: Se're peran ri akun iklan LinkedIn (Penonton atau tinggi).
connect.need2: Se're peran ri halamang perusahaang ni link (Administrator, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator atau Analyst) - LinkedIn naparalluangi untu' a'bage-bage prospek.
connect.need3: Pakkuta'nang nomoro telepon ri Lead Gen Forms - lead punna tena nomoro teleponna takkulleai nitambai.

connection.confirmDisconnect: Putuskan LinkedIn ? Sinkronisasi ammari siagang token akses ni hapus. Timbal balik, statistik siagang catatan kegiatan ni simpan.
connection.noPermission: Ikatte akkullei anciniki anne halamanga. A'sambungang siagang a'pinra setting parallui ijin "Atoro Setting".
connection.fetchHint: Lead beru niparessai tunggala siapa are menit siagang 7 allo ribokoangna niparessai pole tunggala allo, jari tena apa-apa nikaluppa. Pakei anne untuk lead battu ri tenanapa nu assidallekang, iareka untu amparessai pole se're periode (sa'genna 90 allo ri se'rea wattu). Lead yang lebba ri Leadrat ni skip.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Pauangi LinkedIn inai battu ri prospekna a'jari prospek sitojennaya. Punna lead LinkedIn narapi status nu pilea ri yawa, Leadrat na laporo mange ri LinkedIn , jari laporang kampanyenu ampa'piitteang kualitas lead siagang LinkedIn akkullei a'boya tau maraeng sangkamma lead kaminang baji'nu. Iamintu ID lead LinkedIn siagang hash se're arah email ni kirim.
capi.created: Konversi ni paenteng ri LinkedIn siagang ni peta.

activity.title: Catatan kegiatan
activity.intro: Sikontu apa-apa niaka ri alla'na Leadrat siagang LinkedIn : sambungang, sikontu sinkronisasi, sikontu lead siagang apa kajarianga ri ia, konversi siagang kasalang.
